definition.name: jucys_murphy_elements
definition.definition: The Jucys-Murphy elements X_1, X_2, ..., X_n in the group algebra C[S_n] are defined by X_1 = 0 and X_k = sum_{j=1}^{k-1} (j,k) for k >= 2, where (j,k) denotes the transposition swapping positions j and k. Key property (Proposition 2.2): (e + X_n)(e + X_{n-1})...(e + X_1) = sum_{pi in S_n} pi. This gives the symmetric subspace projector via Pi_sym^{n,d} = (1/n!)(e + X_n)...(e + X_1). The recurrence (Proposition 2.3): Pi_sym^{n,d} = ((e+X_n)/n) * ((e+X_{n-1})/(n-1)) * ... * ((e+X_{m+1})/(m+1)) * (Pi_sym^{m,d} tensor I^{tensor(n-m)}).
